title_en: The Stations of Fatima al-Zahra (peace be upon her) and Her Oppression in the Sources of the Ahl al-Sunna (Part 1)
description_en: المرجعية والخلافة بعد الرسول (ص) 27 / جمادي الأول /1433
summary: His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari commences a series on the stations and hardships of Fatima al-Zahra (peace be upon her) as recorded in non-Shi'i sources.
series_en: Debates in Creed - The Religious Authority and the Caliphate after the Messenger
